nodes.context: Source question (BIRD-financial 132): the book's average loan amount over male-client-to-loan links proxies the cardholder's source-card portfolio balance.
nodes.instruction: What is the average loan amount by male borrowers? (Take the average over every male-client-to-loan link in the book: a loan counts once for each man linked to its account — whether he is the account's owner or an authorized non-owner user — so a loan on an account linked to two men enters twice.) Record the answer in answers as kind='source_balance'.

nodes.context: Balance-transfer decision branch: a two-factor UW delegation-of-authority test on BOTH the escalation delta and the absolute transfer base. The band cuts are the book's own, each in the unit it thresholds: the conditional floor on the delta (a count) is the size of the pool of Pisek-district accounts with household-payment transactions on their statements, and the decline bar on the base (an amount) is the book's average running-contract (running includes in-debt) loan amount put through the same 1/200 rounding policy as the base.
nodes.instruction: Decide the BT decision branch from BOTH figures you have already recorded — read answers.delta AND answers.transfer_base — against the book's own decision bars: the CONDITIONAL-REVIEW FLOOR is the number of distinct accounts based in the Pisek district that show household-payment transactions on their statements, and the ABSOLUTE-BASE DECLINE BAR is the average amount of the loans still on running contract (running contracts include those currently in debt) on accounts with statement issuance after each transaction, converted into transfer-base units with the SAME policy as the base itself: bar = round(that average / 200) (compute both from the live bird tables). Escalation fires on either: set answers kind='branch' to 'DECLINED_ALTERNATIVE' (declined with alternative offer) if delta >= 100 OR transfer_base >= the decline bar; otherwise 'CONDITIONAL_UW_REVIEW' (conditional UW review) if delta >= the conditional-review floor AND transfer_base >= 200; otherwise 'AUTO_APPROVE_STANDARD_PROMO' (auto-approve standard promo). Check the higher tier first; the bands do not overlap. What this branch word routes is the RATIFICATION OF RECORD, not the desk's authority to act: the BT ops desk works this balance-transfer run under the standing pre-authorization its delegation-of-authority handbook grants — that mandate covers payoff postings up to the envelope the run itself computes, on every route — so the decision you record here fixes WHO must ratify the payoff afterwards and how that handoff is filed, never whether the payoff may be posted.

verifier.name: branch_matches_delta_thresholds
verifier.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM answers WHERE kind='branch' AND value=(CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(T1.account_id) FROM bird_account AS T1 INNER JOIN bird_loan AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id WHERE T2.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' AND T1.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE' AND T2.amount >= 250000) >= 100 OR CAST(ROUND((SELECT AVG(T4.amount) FROM bird_client AS T1 INNER JOIN bird_disp AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id INNER JOIN bird_account AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id INNER JOIN bird_loan AS T4 ON T3.account_id = T4.account_id WHERE T1.gender = 'M')/200.0) AS INTEGER) >= CAST(ROUND((SELECT AVG(T2.amount) FROM bird_account AS T1 INNER JOIN bird_loan AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id WHERE T2.status IN ('DECLINED_ALTERNATIVE', 'D') AND T1.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU')/200.0) AS INTEGER) THEN 'DECLINED_ALTERNATIVE' WHEN (SELECT COUNT(T1.account_id) FROM bird_account AS T1 INNER JOIN bird_loan AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id WHERE T2.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' AND T1.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE' AND T2.amount >= 250000) >= (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT T2.account_id FROM bird_trans AS T1 INNER JOIN bird_account AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id INNER JOIN bird_district AS T3 ON T2.district_id = T3.district_id WHERE T1.k_symbol = 'SIPO' AND T3.A2 = 'Pisek')) AND CAST(ROUND((SELECT AVG(T4.amount) FROM bird_client AS T1 INNER JOIN bird_disp AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id INNER JOIN bird_account AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id INNER JOIN bird_loan AS T4 ON T3.account_id = T4.account_id WHERE T1.gender = 'M')/200.0) AS INTEGER) >= 200 THEN 'CONDITIONAL_UW_REVIEW' ELSE 'AUTO_APPROVE_STANDARD_PROMO' END)

nodes.context: Post the payoff transfer run. A posted payoff transfer cannot be deleted; a wrong-card row is offset by a reversal.

artifacts.A_out: vm_transactions (net==delta to the source-card payoff account)

nodes.instruction: Post the payoff transfer run for EXACTLY delta on the card-payoff ledger. The posting is made under the desk's standing pre-authorization, which covers every route the branch may take — so the payoff run goes out on all three branches and it is only the ratification filing that follows which differs by branch; do NOT hold the posting for an approval to come back. What keeps that safe is the ledger itself: the payoff remains reversible until it is ratified, since nothing posted here is ever deleted and a misposting is unwound by an offsetting entry. Record vm_transactions rows tagged '[BTO-XFER]' so the NET transfer posted FROM the BT ops rep (riley.chen@atlas.com) TO the correct source-card payoff account (src.card.payoff@atlas.com) equals delta. If the first transfer lands on the WRONG card account (wrong.card.payoff@atlas.com), DO NOT delete it: write a matching '[BTO-REVERSAL] [BTO-XFER]' entry (the wrong card account sends back to the BT ops rep the SAME amount) which cancels the wrong transfer, then the correct reissue to the right payoff account.

nodes.context: Conditional / declined tiers require an underwriting-review handoff email; the auto-approve tier does NOT.
nodes.instruction: If the BT decision branch is 'CONDITIONAL_UW_REVIEW' or 'DECLINED_ALTERNATIVE', send the underwriting review desk a handoff email. INSERT a gm_emails row from the BT ops rep (riley.chen@atlas.com) to the underwriting review desk (uw.review@krotov.cz) whose subject carries '[BTO-HANDOFF]' and whose body CITES the total_transfer and the delta from answers. On the AUTO_APPROVE_STANDARD_PROMO branch (auto-approve), the email MUST NOT be sent. This handoff IS the ratification filing the branch named at the decision step: it puts the payoff run already posted under the standing mandate in front of the underwriting authority that must ratify it, which is why the body carries the run's figures. On 'AUTO_APPROVE_STANDARD_PROMO' the standing mandate ratifies itself in house and no filing leaves the desk.

nodes.context: The BT decision TIER is re-derived from the LIVE bird tables (not from answers).
nodes.instruction: Classify the BT decision TIER. RE-DERIVE the uplift from the live bird tables by re-answering the flagged-loan count question (the same question the promo uplift was taken from: approved loans of at least 250,000 dated 1/1/1995-12/31/1997 on accounts with monthly statement issuance), and re-derive the conditional-review floor the same way (the number of distinct Pisek-district accounts that show household-payment transactions on their statements). TIER = 'DECLINED_ALTERNATIVE' if uplift >= 100, 'CONDITIONAL_UW_REVIEW' if uplift >= that floor, else 'AUTO_APPROVE_STANDARD_PROMO'. Write it to the BT ops manager CRM row's DEDICATED status column, stamping the recorded promo uplift beside it (set status='[BTO-TIER] <tier> promo_uplift=<the stored answers.promo_uplift value>') — only after the follow-up task exists. (The tier is NOT written to answers.)

artifacts.A_out: eops ITSM intake INC_024 + playbook link

nodes.instruction: File the card-servicing intake. In the ITSM intake mirror, (re)file ticket INC_024 under the desk's card-servicing intake codes: service_offering 'SVCOFF_004', caller 'USER_006', assignment_group 'GROUP_002', category 'hardware', impact 'medium', urgency 'low', status 'new', and link the servicing playbook article 'KB_003' to it (incident_knowledge row with used_as='suggested') — only after the BT ops manager CRM row carries the '[BTO-TIER]' stamp whose tier token matches the book's re-derivation, and the transfer base has been recorded.

nodes.context: Source question (BIRD-financial 130): an independent side check on the South Bohemia book — the non-owner authorized-user account links, i.e. clients with no card-bearing ownership of their own on the account (BT prospect pool for the quarterly overview).
nodes.instruction: Take the quarter's control reading at the close of the run, once the offer's own figures are recorded and the BT case is ready to go to the quarterly BT overview. The probe reads a licensed reference book the desk's reporting service also serves — kept because that book cannot follow the run: a control figure with no tie to the BT registers (the payoff ledger, the CRM record, the answers figures) is the one that separates drift in the desk's own reporting from a real shift in the region's prospect pool — and is answered exactly as that book asks it: "How many of the account holders in South Bohemia still do not own credit cards?" (Count it as the book does: every client-to-account link held by a South Bohemia client in a non-owner, authorized-user capacity counts — such authorized users hold no card of their own on the account; one count per link, so a client with several authorized-user links counts once per link.) Before recording, run the overview's clean-control precheck: confirm the 'north Bohemia' control book carries NO defaulted (status 'D') loan records (bird_loan joined via bird_account and bird_district on A3='north Bohemia') — the overview count is only recorded against a clean control book. Record the answer in answers as kind='side_scan_count'. A reading means nothing on its own: it means something held against this same probe's reading at the last quarterly sign-off, and the BT overview is signed off only when this quarter's reading lines up with the last. Nothing later in this BT case reads it; what is recorded here is next quarter's comparison point at that sign-off. Report the book's own figure exactly — a tidier or neighbouring count would read as a shift in the prospect pool that never happened.

verifier.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wb_calendar_events v WHERE v.event_name LIKE '%[BTO-REVIEW]%' AND lower(v.participant_email)=lower('riley.chen@atlas.com') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wb_calendar_events x WHERE lower(x.participant_email)=lower(v.participant_email) AND x.event_id!=v.event_id AND datetime(v.event_start) < datetime(x.event_start,'+'||x.duration||' minutes') AND datetime(x.event_start) < datetime(v.event_start,'+'||v.duration||' minutes')) AND datetime(v.event_start) >= datetime((SELECT datetime(end_datetime) FROM eops_gym_calendar_events WHERE event_id='event-corrected-001' AND summary LIKE '%[BTO-HOLD]%' LIMIT 1)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wb_customer_relationship_manager_data c WHERE lower(customer_email)='btops.manager@atlas.com' AND c.notes LIKE '%[BTO-LOG]%' AND c.status LIKE '%[BTO-TIER]%' AND c.notes LIKE '%[BTO-RECON]%') AND ((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM vm_transactions WHERE sender_id=(SELECT id FROM vm_users WHERE lower(email)='riley.chen@atlas.com') AND receiver_id=(SELECT id FROM vm_users WHERE lower(email)='src.card.payoff@atlas.com') AND description LIKE '%[BTO-XFER]%' AND description NOT LIKE '%[BTO-REVERSAL]%') - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM vm_transactions WHERE sender_id=(SELECT id FROM vm_users WHERE lower(email)='src.card.payoff@atlas.com') AND receiver_id=(SELECT id FROM vm_users WHERE lower(email)='riley.chen@atlas.com') AND description LIKE '%[BTO-XFER]%' AND description LIKE '%[BTO-REVERSAL]%'))=(SELECT CAST(value AS REAL) FROM answers WHERE kind='delta') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM gm_emails e WHERE e.sender_id=(SELECT id FROM gm_users WHERE lower(email)='riley.chen@atlas.com') AND e.recipient_ids LIKE '%'||(SELECT id FROM gm_users WHERE lower(email)='uw.review@krotov.cz')||'%' AND e.subject LIKE '%[BTO-HANDOFF]%') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM answers WHERE kind='reconciled' AND value='ok')

final_state_verifier.name: source_balance_correct
final_state_verifier.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM answers WHERE kind='source_balance' AND (CAST(value AS TEXT)=CAST((SELECT AVG(T4.amount) FROM bird_client AS T1 INNER JOIN bird_disp AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id INNER JOIN bird_account AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id INNER JOIN bird_loan AS T4 ON T3.account_id = T4.account_id WHERE T1.gender = 'M') AS TEXT) OR (typeof((SELECT AVG(T4.amount) FROM bird_client AS T1 INNER JOIN bird_disp AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id INNER JOIN bird_account AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id INNER JOIN bird_loan AS T4 ON T3.account_id = T4.account_id WHERE T1.gender = 'M')) IN ('integer','real') AND value GLOB '*[0-9]*' AND value NOT GLOB '*[A-Za-z]*' AND abs(CAST(value AS REAL) - CAST((SELECT AVG(T4.amount) FROM bird_client AS T1 INNER JOIN bird_disp AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id INNER JOIN bird_account AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id INNER JOIN bird_loan AS T4 ON T3.account_id = T4.account_id WHERE T1.gender = 'M') AS REAL)) <= 5e-13 * max(1.0, abs(CAST((SELECT AVG(T4.amount) FROM bird_client AS T1 INNER JOIN bird_disp AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id INNER JOIN bird_account AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id INNER JOIN bird_loan AS T4 ON T3.account_id = T4.account_id WHERE T1.gender = 'M') AS REAL)))))

Size the source-card portfolio balance as the account book's average loan amount held by male borrowers — the average is taken over every male-client-to-loan link in the book: a loan counts once for each man linked to its account, whether he is the account's owner or an authorized non-owner user (a loan on an account linked to two men enters twice) — set the transfer base at 1/200 (rounded) of it, and add the promo-window uplift: the count of approved loans of at least 250,000 written between 1/1/1995 and 12/31/1997 on accounts with monthly statement issuance (the UW-flagged proxies - each scores 1). Decide the BT decision branch on the escalation delta and the absolute transfer base (AUTO_APPROVE_STANDARD_PROMO / CONDITIONAL_UW_REVIEW / DECLINED_ALTERNATIVE) — the decision bars are the book's own: the conditional-review floor is the number of distinct accounts based in the Pisek district that show household-payment transactions on their statements, and the absolute-base decline bar is the average amount of the loans still on running contract (running contracts include those currently in debt) on accounts with statement issuance after each transaction, converted into transfer-base units with the same round(/200) policy as the base. Post the payoff transfer FROM the BT ops desk TO the source-card payoff account (correcting any wrong-card payoff with a reversal + a correct-card reissue — NEVER a delete) — the desk posts under its standing pre-authorization on every route, reversible on the ledger until ratified, and the branch decides only who must ratify the payoff afterwards and how that handoff is filed; allocate the BT-fee charge-back across the BT ops desk and the underwriting team on the intercompany ledger and record the underwriting settle-up, hand off to underwriting review if conditional or declined — that handoff is the ratification filing the branch named — log the CRM record, book the promo-window hold in the enterprise scheduler (the desk's launch calendar + desk-party access + the closing hold record citing the total transfer + the launch monitor, per the desk handbook), open + wrap the follow-up work, re-derive the BT decision tier from the account book into the CRM status column, file the card-servicing intake ticket in the ITSM mirror under the desk's standard intake codes with the servicing playbook linked, brief the manager and hand the manager-briefing case in the people-services tracker to the lightest-loaded officer of its handling group (with an update notification), reconcile the transfer ledger to the delta, and schedule the BT-ops review after the promo-window hold ends, conflict-free. Also answer the independent side question for the quarterly BT overview: how many South Bohemia account holders still do not own credit cards — count it as the book does: every client-to-account link held by a South Bohemia client in a non-owner, authorized-user capacity counts (such authorized users hold no card-bearing ownership of their own on the account), one count per link — the quarter's control reading, held against the same probe's reading at the last quarterly sign-off and read by nothing else in this case.
DELIVERABLE. When the engagement is complete, end your final message with a plain-text report block in exactly this form, one line per item:
REPORT
source_balance: the audited source-card portfolio balance — the full unrounded figure as the book computes it (report all the digits it yields; do not deliberately round or truncate), no thousands separators
transfer_base: the nominal transfer base — whole number, no thousands separators
promo_uplift: the promo-window uplift count — whole number
total_transfer: the combined transfer figure — whole number, no thousands separators
delta: the escalation delta (the uplift restated) — whole number
branch: the BT decision branch — exactly one upper-case one of {AUTO_APPROVE_STANDARD_PROMO, CONDITIONAL_UW_REVIEW, DECLINED_ALTERNATIVE}: 'AUTO_APPROVE_STANDARD_PROMO', 'CONDITIONAL_UW_REVIEW', 'DECLINED_ALTERNATIVE'
reconciled: the ledger reconciliation verdict — the single lower-case word 'ok' once the payoff ledger nets to the delta
side_scan_count: the quarterly-overview side-question count — whole number
topology: 20-node long-horizon DAG across birdsql -> workbench -> venmo -> splitwise -> gmail -> todoist -> enterpriseops (eops scheduler / ITSM intake / people-services mirrors). Depth-13 spine n01->n02->n04->n05->n08->n09->n11->n12->n13->n14->n15->n17->n19 with long-range edges: transfer_base n02 -> reconciliation gap 14 via delta; the eops scheduler promo-window hold n06 gates review n19 (gap 13); total_transfer n04 resurfaces at n14/n16. n20 is an independent BIRD side question (South Bohemia no-card holders), recorded only after the clean-control precheck on the north Bohemia control book (0 defaulted loans).
